overview:
**Fire danger is Moderate today in the Montrose (High Elevation) FDRA, driven by dry fuels and gusty winds even as cooler, wetter weather moves in.**
- Danger is forecast to ease to Low by Sunday (Oct 25) and stay there through the week as rain chances rise and winds calm.
- Saturday brings a cold front with showers and thunderstorms likely (80% chance) and gusts up to 30 mph, a brief fire-weather concern before conditions improve.
- No Red Flag Warning or local watchout thresholds are active (0 of 7 met) as of today.
- No burn restrictions are currently in effect in Montrose County; Ouray County has also rescinded all restrictions, and BLM Gunnison Field Office lifted its Stage 1 order in September — always verify locally before burning.
- No active wildfires are being reported in or near this area's counties today.
